about: Measured from the vanilla prefabs by lab/extract_models.py (render bounds of the LOD0 meshes, solid colliders, in the piece's own frame, metres) and a low-poly proxy per piece: boxes (c center, s size, q rotation) and prisms (p outline in the part's x-y plane, d depth along its z), each with a color sampled from the game texture (col) and a material class (m). Built by lab/build_models.js.
